camel_example: aliyun dts ConfigureMigrationJob --region cn-hangzhou --DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType RDS --MigrationMode.StructureIntialization true --SourceEndpoint.InstanceType RDS --MigrationObject 'DBName_:_dtstestdata_,_TableIncludes_:_TableName_:_customer' --MigrationMode.DataSynchronization true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --MigrationJobName MySQL_TO_RDS --MigrationMode.DataIntialization true --MigrationJobId dtsxxxxxxxx
description_en: Configures a legacy data migration task
kebab_example: aliyun dts configure-migration-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtsxxxxxxxx --migration-job-name MySQL_TO_RDS --source-endpoint-instance-type RDS --destination-endpoint-instance-type RDS --migration-mode-structure-intialization true --migration-mode-data-intialization true --migration-mode-data-synchronization true --migration-object DBName_:_dtstestdata_,_TableIncludes_:_TableName_:_customer --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigureMigrationJob

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the data migration instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html.
The region ID must be the same as the region ID of the destination database
parameters.help_zh:
数据迁移实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html。
与目标库所属的地域ID保持一致
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration instance. You can call the DescribeMigrationJobs operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeMigrationJobs接口查询
parameters.name: migration_job_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the migration task. The name can be up to 32 characters in length. Specify a descriptive name for easy identification. The name does not need to be unique
parameters.help_zh: 迁移任务名称，不超过32个字符。建议配置具有业务意义的名称（无唯一性要求），便于后续识别
parameters.name: migration_job_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the source database. Valid values:
RDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
ECS: Self-managed database hosted on Elastic Compute Service (ECS).
LocalInstance: Self-managed database with a public IP address.
Express: Self-managed database connected over Express Connect, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway.
dg: Self-managed database connected over Database Gateway.
cen: Self-managed database connected over Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN).
MongoDB: ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.
POLARDB: PolarDB for MySQL or PolarDB for PostgreSQL cluster.
PolarDB_o: PolarDB for Oracle cluster
parameters.help_zh:
源库的实例类型，取值：
RDS：阿里云RDS实例。
ECS：ECS上的自建数据库。
LocalInstance：有公网IP的自建数据库。
Express：通过专线/VPN网关/智能接入网关接入的自建数据库。
dg：通过数据库网关DG接入的自建数据库。
cen：通过云企业网CEN接入的自建数据库。
MongoDB：阿里云MongoDB实例。
POLARDB：阿里云PolarDB MySQL、PolarDB PostgreSQL。
PolarDB_o：阿里云PolarDB O引擎集群
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance.
This parameter is available and required only when SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to RDS, ECS, Express, MongoDB, POLARDB, or PolarDB_o. You must specify the corresponding instance ID. For example, if the value is ECS, specify the ID of the ECS instance.
When SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to Express, specify the VPC ID
parameters.help_zh:
源库的实例ID。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为RDS、ECS、Express、MongoDB、POLARDB或PolarDB_o时，本参数才可用且必须传入对应的实例ID（例如取值为ECS，则本参数传入ECS实例的ID）。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为Express时，本参数传入VPC ID（即专有网络ID）
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine of the source database. Valid values: MySQL, TiDB, SQLServer, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis, POLARDB, and polardb_pg.
This parameter is available and required only when DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType is set to RDS, POLARDB, ECS, LocalInstance, or Express
parameters.help_zh:
源库的数据库类型，取值：MySQL、TiDB、SQLServer、PostgreSQL、Oracle、MongoDB、Redis、POLARDB、polardb_pg。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为RDS、POLARDB、ECS、LocalInstance或Express时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: source_endpoint_engine_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the source database resides.
When SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to LocalInstance, you can specify cn-hangzhou or the ID of the region that is closest to your self-managed database. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh:
源库所属的地域ID。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为LocalInstance时，您可以传入cn-hangzhou或者离自建数据库地物理距离最近的地域ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: source_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of the source database.
This parameter is available and required only when SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to LocalInstance or Express
parameters.help_zh:
源库的连接地址。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为LocalInstance或Express时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: source_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The service port number of the source database.
This parameter is available and required only when SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to ECS, LocalInstance, or Express
parameters.help_zh:
源库的服务端口。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType取值为ECS、LocalInstance或Express时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: source_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The system ID (SID) of the Oracle database.
This parameter is available and required only when SourceEndpoint.EngineName is set to Oracle and the Oracle database is a non-Real Application Cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
Oracle数据库的SID信息。
当SourceEndpoint.EngineName取值为Oracle，且Oracle数据库为非RAC实例时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: source_endpoint_oracle_sid

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database to be migrated or the authentication database.
This parameter is available and required only when SourceEndpoint.EngineName is set to PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
When SourceEndpoint.EngineName is set to PostgreSQL, specify the name of the database to be migrated. When it is set to MongoDB, specify the name of the authentication database for the database account
parameters.help_zh:
待迁移的数据库名称或鉴权数据库名称。
当SourceEndpoint.EngineName取值为PostgreSQL或MongoDB时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
当SourceEndpoint.EngineName取值为PostgreSQL时，传入待迁移的数据库名称；取值为MongoDB时，传入数据库账号的鉴权数据库名称
parameters.name: source_endpoint_database_name

parameters.help_en:
The database account of the source database.

Note: The required permissions vary based on the database engine. For more information, see the corresponding configuration examples in the migration overview
parameters.help_zh:
源库的数据库账号。

说明 迁移不同的数据库所需的权限有所差异，详情请参见迁移方案概览中对应的配置案例
parameters.name: source_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the source database account
parameters.help_zh: 源库数据库账号对应的密码
parameters.name: source_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the source instance belongs.
This parameter is active and required only when you configure a cross-account data migration task
parameters.help_zh:
源实例所属的阿里云账号ID。
仅在配置跨阿里云账号的数据迁移时本参数才可用，且必须传入
parameters.name: source_endpoint_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The RAM role that is authorized to the destination Alibaba Cloud account to access the source instance. This parameter is required when the source and destination instances belong to different Alibaba Cloud accounts.
For more information about the required permissions and authorization method, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48468.html
parameters.help_zh:
当源实例与目标实例所属阿里云账号不同时，需传入该参数，来指定源实例的授权角色，以允许目标实例阿里云账号访问源实例的实例信息。
角色所需的权限及授权方式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/48468.html
parameters.name: source_endpoint_role

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the destination database. Valid values:
ECS: Self-managed database hosted on ECS.
LocalInstance: Self-managed database with a public IP address.
RDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
DRDS: PolarDB-X instance.
MongoDB: ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.
Redis: ApsaraDB for Redis instance.
PetaData: HybridDB for MySQL instance.
POLARDB: PolarDB for MySQL or PolarDB for PostgreSQL cluster.
PolarDB_o: PolarDB for Oracle cluster.
AnalyticDB: AnalyticDB for MySQL 3.0 or 2.0 cluster.
Greenplum: AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
目标库的实例类型，取值：
ECS：ECS上的自建数据库。
LocalInstance：有公网IP的自建数据库。
RDS：阿里云RDS实例。
DRDS：阿里云PolarDB-X实例。
MongoDB：阿里云MongoDB实例。
Redis：阿里云Redis实例。
PetaData：阿里云HybridDB for MySQL实例。
POLARDB：阿里云PolarDB MySQL、PolarDB PostgreSQL。
PolarDB_o：阿里云PolarDB O引擎集群。
AnalyticDB：阿里云云原生数据仓库AnalyticDB MySQL 3.0和2.0版本。
Greenplum：阿里云云原生数据仓库AnalyticDB PostgreSQL
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination instance.
This parameter is available and required only when DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType is set to RDS, ECS, MongoDB, Redis, DRDS, PetaData, OceanBase, POLARDB, PolarDB_o, AnalyticDB, or Greenplum. You must specify the corresponding instance ID. For example, if the value is ECS, specify the ID of the ECS instance
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例ID。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为RDS、ECS、MongoDB、Redis、DRDS、PetaData、OceanBase、POLARDB、PolarDB_o、AnalyticDB或Greenplum时，本参数才可用且必须传入对应的实例ID（例如取值为ECS，则需要传入ECS实例ID）
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine of the destination database. Valid values: MySQL, DRDS, SQLServer, PostgreSQL, PPAS, MongoDB, Redis, POLARDB, and polardb_pg.
This parameter is available and required only when DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType is set to RDS, POLARDB, ECS, LocalInstance, or Express
parameters.help_zh:
目标库的数据库类型。取值：MySQL、DRDS、SQLServer、PostgreSQL、PPAS、MongoDB、Redis、POLARDB、polardb_pg
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为RDS、POLARDB、ECS、LocalInstance或Express时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_engine_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the destination database resides.
When DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType is set to LocalInstance, you can specify cn-hangzhou or the ID of the region that is closest to your self-managed database. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh:
目标库所属的地域ID。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为LocalInstance时，您可以传入cn-hangzhou或者离自建数据库地物理距离最近的地域ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of the destination database.
This parameter is available and required only when DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType is set to LocalInstance or Express
parameters.help_zh:
目标库的连接地址。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为LocalInstance或Express时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The service port number of the destination database.
This parameter is available and required only when DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType is set to ECS, LocalInstance, or Express
parameters.help_zh:
目标库的服务端口。
当DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType取值为ECS、LocalInstance或Express时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The name of the destination database or the authentication database. 
This parameter is available and required only when DestinationEndpoint.EngineName is set to PostgreSQL, DRDS, or MongoDB.
When DestinationEndpoint.EngineName is set to PostgreSQL or DRDS, specify the name of the database to be migrated. When it is set to MongoDB, specify the name of the authentication database for the database account
parameters.help_zh:
待迁入的数据库名称或鉴权数据库名称。 
当DestinationEndpoint.EngineName取值为PostgreSQL、DRDS或MongoDB时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
当DestinationEndpoint.EngineName取值为PostgreSQL或DRDS时，传入待迁移的数据库名称；取值为MongoDB时，传入数据库账号的鉴权数据库名称
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_data_base_name

parameters.help_en:
The database account of the destination database.

Note: The required permissions vary based on the database engine. For more information, see the corresponding configuration examples in the migration overview
parameters.help_zh:
目标库的数据库账号。

说明 迁移不同的数据库所需的权限有所差异，详情请参见迁移方案概览中对应的配置案例
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the destination database account
parameters.help_zh: 目标库数据库账号的密码
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform schema migration. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No.

The support for schema migration varies based on the database engine. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26618.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否进行结构迁移，取值：
true：是。
false：否。

DTS对结构迁移的支持情况因数据库类型不同而有所差异，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26618.html
parameters.name: migration_mode_structure_intialization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform full data migration. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No.

The support for full data migration varies based on the database engine. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26618.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否进行全量数据迁移，取值：
true：是。
false：否。

DTS对全量数据迁移的支持情况因数据库类型不同而有所差异，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26618.html
parameters.name: migration_mode_data_intialization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform incremental data migration. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No.

The support for incremental data migration varies based on the database engine. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26618.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否进行增量数据迁移，取值：
true：是。
false：否。

DTS对增量数据迁移的支持情况因数据库类型不同而有所差异，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26618.html
parameters.name: migration_mode_data_synchronization

parameters.help_en: The objects to be migrated. The value is a JSON string and supports specific regular expressions. For more information, see [Configure migration objects](~141901~)
parameters.help_zh: 待迁移对象，格式为json串且支持一定的正则表达式，详细说明请参见[迁移对象配置说明](~141901~)
parameters.name: migration_object

parameters.help_en: The reserved parameters of DTS. The value is a JSON string. You can specify this parameter to meet specific requirements, such as specifying whether to automatically start a precheck. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176470.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS预留参数，格式为JSON串，您可以传入本参数实现特殊需求（例如是否自动启动预检查）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/176470.html
parameters.name: migration_reserved

parameters.help_en: The start checkpoint for incremental data migration. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 增量数据迁移的启动位点，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: checkpoint

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter is pending deprecation
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The SID of the Oracle database.
This parameter is available and required only when DestinationEndpoint.EngineName is set to Oracle and the Oracle database is a non-Real Application Cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
Oracle数据库的SID信息。
当DestinationEndpoint.EngineName取值为Oracle，且Oracle数据库为非RAC实例时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_oracle_sid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
